title: Proposition K -- Great Highway
verdict_line: Proposition K passed citywide but divided westside neighborhoods directly affected.
stakes: Whether to close the Great Highway to cars is decided by citywide voters, but impacts concentrate in Sunset and Richmond.
record_gap: Community testimony spans 12 statements and 1,711 forum comments. Official decisions include passage of Prop K, loss of CEQA challenge, and pending appeal.
do_next: Retarget persuasion to eastside districts; westside voters have already decided.
Lead with local traffic impact data in eastside voter outreach.
Check FPPC and SF Ethics disclosure requirements for ballot measure spending.
